rationale: A 20% VALIDATION reserve supports controlled model, fusion, and calibration selection without TEST use.
A full chronological 20% future TEST reserve strengthens final evaluation protection.
T1 consumes only the chronologically earliest 20% of that TEST reserve to detect catastrophic end-to-end defects after authorization.
T2 preserves the chronologically latest 80% of TEST as the main untouched final predictive evidence.
reporting_commitment: The thesis and article will identify 70/15/15 as the original plan and 60/20/20 with 4/16 release as the pre-performance methodological amendment.
scientific_equivalence: The thesis objective remains temporally causal within-project and cross-project multimodal evaluation; only the predeclared development/evidence allocation changes.
temporal_causality: All boundaries remain chronological under raw UTC time and SHA tie-break; no row is shuffled.
test_protection: The amendment enlarges the future reserve from 15% to 20%, limits T1 to 4 total percentage points, and leaves 16 points untouched for T2.
